records.section_heading: INABILITY OF STREAM-WATER TO DISSOLVE SUBMARINE LIMESTONES.
records.question: What ratio of Fagaalu spring-water to sea-water produced an approximately neutral solution in the mixing experiments reported?
records.ground_truth_answer: Mixing 100 volumes of Fagaalu spring-water with 20 volumes of sea-water produced an approximately neutral solution (about PH 6.95–7.0).
ground_truth_chunks:
```
100 c. c. spring-water and 100 c. c. sea-water gave a mixture of 8.0 PH. 100 c. c. spring-water and 25 c. c. sea-water gave a mixture of 7.1 PH. 100 c. c. spring-water and 20 c. c. sea-water gave a mixture of 6.95 PH. 100 c. c. spring-water and 10 c. c. sea-water gave a mixture of 6.6 PH.
```
Thus 20 volumes of sea-water give a neutral solution if mixed with 100 volumes of Fagaalu spring-water at 25° C.
